0022600088.text: Both teams open their 2026-27 seasons when Toronto hosts Chicago, and the Raptors will be without Brandon Ingram, who is out after Achilles surgery, while Nate Bittle is day-to-day with a foot issue and a game-time decision. Chicago's Nic Claxton is also day-to-day with a hamstring issue and a game-time decision, and the Raptors won the 2025-26 season series 3-0, including a 139-109 win in Chicago on March 18, 2026. ESPN's matchup predictor gives Toronto a 75% chance to win.
